title: Divergent strategies and convergent outcomes in autonomous materials discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.23957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific agents are mostly evaluated on whether they complete tasks or recover known results; we instead study variation across repeated open-ended campaigns. Sixteen separately initialized sessions of one model-harness configuration received a frozen database of 12,499 metal-organic frameworks, a methane-storage objective, a pinned protocol and a one-week budget. Strategies diverged into four approaches spanning 100--5,000 screened structures, and eight built 2,253 hypothetical structures. Yet the agents recovered the same materials frontier near 200 cm^3/cm^3, and an independent calculation of the database's porous region found its nine best structures all among their reports. translated_title: 自主材料发现中的策略分化与结果趋同
translated_abstract: 科学智能体大多根据其能否完成任务或复现已知结果来评估；我们转而研究重复进行的开放式科研活动中的差异。十六个独立初始化的会话（采用同一模型-工具链配置）获得了一个包含12,499个金属有机框架的冻结数据库、一个甲烷存储目标、一个固定协议和为期一周的预算。各会话的策略分化为四种方法，筛选的结构数量从100到5,000不等，其中八个会话构建了2,253个假想结构。然而，这些智能体都复现了接近200 cm³/cm³的相同材料前沿，且对数据库多孔区域的独立计算表明，其九个最佳结构均出现在智能体的报告中。对一半智能体实施的强制检查将新运行的复现率从八分之一提升至八分之八，但未能显著改善结论的有效性，因为十六个智能体中有十五个选择了同一个被审计排除的条目——一个不完整的结构，其相关信息（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 通过让16个独立运行的自主科学智能体在相同条件下进行开放式材料发现，研究发现尽管智能体的策略高度分化，最终却收敛到相同的材料前沿，且强制检查虽能提升运行复现性，却无法提高结论的有效性。
en_tdlr: Running sixteen independent open-ended campaigns of an autonomous scientific agent on metal-organic framework discovery, this study finds that divergent strategies converge on the same materials frontier, and that enforced checks improve run reproducibility but not conclusion validity.
